races.paceDynamic: Deedaydiva stands out as the sole confirmed front-runner and will take them along at a comfortable gallop over this testing 1m2½f trip. With only Eskimo Pie, Brighlee and Tashi Delek likely to race prominently, there's minimal early pressure which allows Deedaydiva to dictate terms. The modest pace will set up a tactical finish where positioning and stamina become crucial. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can unleash late kicks, particularly those with proven stamina at the distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays modest and runners bunch up turning for home
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop plays into the hands of hold-up horses with tactical speed who can quicken when it matters. Botagoz and Palace Artois can time their runs perfectly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Speed Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Deedaydiva gets soft fractions and the closers leave it too late
scenarios.body: The front-runner or those tracking closely can sustain their effort to the line over this stamina-sapping trip. Deedaydiva's class edge combined with Eskimo Pie's consistent prominent style could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Newcomer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the highly-rated debutants shows natural ability and gets a dream run
scenarios.body: The superior breeding and ratings of the newcomers shine through despite their inexperience. Concealed Passion or Midnight Steppers could exploit the tactical nature with raw talent.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens unexpectedly or the ground becomes more testing
scenarios.body: The race becomes a true stamina examination where previous distance form becomes paramount. Echo Valley's experience at longer trips could prove the difference despite modest ratings.

watchPoints.text: Deedaydiva must handle the 231-day layoff and prove the class edge translates after the long absence
Palace Artois and Echo Valley could be overlooked despite their proven stamina and tactical advantages in this race shape
The Haggas-trained newcomer Shadida may show more than expected given the stable's pattern with well-bred fillies
Botagoz's 129-day break is a concern but Varian's hold-up horses often improve significantly for racing room
Market support for any of the four debutants would be highly significant given their lightly-raced status

races.paceDynamic: Frantic is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead, with Egotistical likely to settle just behind in second. The three unknowns (Sweet Desire, Elshie, Unique Procedure) add uncertainty but as maidens are unlikely to be aggressive early pace factors. With most of the field holding up (Bintaryana, Mehmas Engine, Always Perfect, Nzuri, Hen Party), Frantic can dictate fractions and kick clear when ready. This sustainable pace scenario heavily favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses who need a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Frantic gets the expected soft lead with Egotistical tracking
scenarios.body: Frantic can control the tempo and has enough in reserve from her recent efforts, while the hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage in a slowly-run race. The prominent pair get first run on a field that needs time to wind up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Unknown Presses Pace
scenarios.trigger: If one of the three lightly-raced fillies shows early speed to challenge Frantic
scenarios.body: This creates the stronger gallop that suits the hold-up horses, particularly Hen Party and Mehmas Engine who have shown consistent form at this trip. The pace duel could set up a closer finish with late runners getting involved.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If both Frantic and Egotistical go forward together and engage early
scenarios.body: The two form horses neutralize each other's tactical advantages, opening the door for a fresh filly with natural ability. This moderate pace still favours those with some early position over pure hold-up types.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Frantic disappoints or the pace becomes pedestrian throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the most progressive filly with the best recent form can capitalize. Mehmas Engine's recent consistency and Hen Party's multiple placings make them best equipped for this scenario.

watchPoints.text: Watch if any of the three unknowns (Sweet Desire, Elshie, Unique Procedure) show early speed to pressure Frantic's expected lead

races.paceDynamic: Seven Of Hearts, I'm Dan Dare, and Takincareofbizness will clash for the early lead in this sprint, creating a fierce gallop from the start. With 17 runners over 5 furlongs on turf, the pace will be relentless as these three confirmed front-runners battle for position. The strong early gallop will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the final furlong. This punishing pace scenario heavily favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble early and finish strongly when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Scorching Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and tie up badly in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The blistering gallop set by Seven Of Hearts, I'm Dan Dare and Takincareofbizness will crack them all late. Patient hold-up horses like Hellcat and Faithful Dream can sweep past the exhausted pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but sustainable, allowing handy horses to strike
scenarios.body: Rosieisme Darling and Staniel Cay can track the leaders without getting embroiled in the early battle. They can kick clear when the front three weaken but before the back markers arrive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets first run and the pace is just sustainable enough
scenarios.body: Seven Of Hearts or Takincareofbizness could steal a march turning for home if they avoid the worst of the early pace war. The winner would need to be the smartest of the three speed horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Total Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go suicidally fast and completely collapse
scenarios.body: The entire front division will stop dramatically, allowing the deepest closers to come from last to first. Horses like Amakhala and No Claims Bonus could benefit from an extreme pace scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Brazen stands as the lone confirmed front runner in this 8-horse field, meaning she can dictate terms from flag to finish without early pressure. With Level Up, Papa Don't Preach, High Opinion, Initial Blue and Jeany May all showing prominent tendencies, there will be plenty of horses tracking the leader but none committed to challenging for the early lead. This creates a tactical race where Miss Brazen can control fractions, with the prominent brigade settling behind and the two hold-up horses Winchurch and Scent Of May needing the pace to collapse late. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the uncontested leader and strike when she weakens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Brazen maintains a steady tempo without excessive early pressure from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The lone leader keeps enough in reserve to resist late challenges, while prominent runners find themselves in a stop-start affair that blunts their finishing kicks. Hold-up horses Winchurch and Scent Of May get little help from the sedate gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Level Up, Papa Don't Preach or Initial Blue apply sustained pressure to Miss Brazen from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop plays into the hands of horses that can track and pounce, with Miss Brazen's long stint in front telling against her in the final furlong. The faster tempo also brings hold-up horses into contention.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the final 2f with Miss Brazen stopping quickly after controlling throughout
scenarios.body: Winchurch and Scent Of May benefit from the slow early gallop, sweeping up from the rear as the prominent runners engage in a war of attrition. The race becomes a sprint from the 1f pole.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If Jeany May or High Opinion find a dream run on the rails while the favourites mark each other
scenarios.body: The unfancied runners capitalize on tactical errors from the market leaders, with their prominent style allowing them to strike when others are caught flat-footed. Class concerns are negated by superior positioning.

watchPoints.text: Miss Brazen's 183-day absence could see her blow up when challenged if ring-rusty despite controlling early

Winchurch and Scent Of May need to track closer than usual given the likely moderate pace scenario

races.paceDynamic: Highland Olly provides the only confirmed lead, setting a likely comfortable tempo without early pressure in this 1m½f contest. The real congestion sits behind with Influential, Moonjid, Pulsar Star and Oceans Five all wanting prominent positions, creating a bunched group that could get messy approaching the home turn. With three hold-up horses (Kokanee, Commander Of Life, Pension Pot) sitting further back, the race sets up as a tactical affair where positioning will be crucial. This pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can avoid the mid-race traffic and deliver their challenge with a clear run from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Highland Olly sets steady fractions and the prominent quartet get tangled up 2f out
scenarios.body: The backmarkers get perfect splits as the pace collapses, with the patient ride proving decisive in a race where tactical positioning trumps early speed. Kokanee and Commander Of Life emerge with telling late runs to mop up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Resolves
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners sort themselves out cleanly and avoid traffic problems
scenarios.body: Moonjid or Influential use their class advantage to surge clear of the congestion, with De Sousa's race-riding or Varian's horses getting the job done despite the crowded theatre. The pace stays honest enough to keep hold-up horses at bay.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Highland Olly Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If no one challenges Highland Olly's early lead and he gets soft sectionals throughout
scenarios.body: The front-runner exploits the tactical battle behind to steal a march turning in, holding on grimly as the closers come too late to peg him back. His recent Goodwood win gives him confidence to repeat the front-running formula.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Highland Olly goes too slow and the field bunches into a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with any horse getting a clear run capable of winning, turning it into pure lottery territory. Form and ratings matter less than who avoids the inevitable trouble in running.

races.paceDynamic: In The Post and Star Start are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, ensuring an honest gallop from the start. With 15 runners and two eager pace-setters, the tempo should be solid throughout the 1m2f trip on good ground at Nottingham. The sustained pace will stretch the field and create gaps for late-running types to exploit. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can finish late, as the early pace battle between the leaders will set up a tactical advantage for those settling off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If In The Post and Star Start both go forward aggressively from the start
scenarios.body: The two leaders engage early, creating an honest tempo that suits the plentiful hold-up horses in the field. Late runners like Law Supreme and Dream Pirate can time their runs perfectly as the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Modest Early Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front runners settles more conservatively than expected
scenarios.body: A steadier pace allows prominent racers like Joseph and Kasgani to position closer without over-racing. The reduced early pace means stamina becomes more important than finishing kick over the extended trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If In The Post and Star Start duel too fiercely through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The two pace-setters weaken dramatically in the final furlong, creating opportunities for the deepest closers. Horses held up furthest back like Bearwith and Bay Dream Believer benefit most from the strong early fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Star Start or In The Post gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The pace-setter dictates comfortable fractions and has enough left to repel late challengers. This unlikely scenario requires the other front runner to settle or miss the break completely.

races.paceDynamic: Back From Dubai stands out as the sole confirmed front runner in this field, giving him a huge tactical advantage at this distance where sustained pace pressure is crucial. With most rivals preferring hold-up or midfield positions (Sceptic, Al Baahy, Fifty Sent, Molly Marine, Bizarre Law, Tilsworth Max), Back From Dubai can dictate terms from the front without pressure. The prominent runners Evelyn's Phoenix, Freedom Bay and Penny Ghent may try to track him but lack the natural speed to apply early pressure. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and any horse that can sit close to the pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses in the straight with limited room to manoeuvre.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Back From Dubai jumps cleanly and gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: He can dictate a steady gallop and kick clear when the pace lifts, with the hold-up horses having too much ground to make up. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for a decisive move.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners successfully shadows Back From Dubai
scenarios.body: Evelyn's Phoenix or Penny Ghent can sit in the perfect stalking position and time their challenge to perfection when Back From Dubai tires. They get the ideal trip tracking the pace without doing the donkey work.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and bunches the field
scenarios.body: The closers like Al Baahy or Fifty Sent can use their finishing kick to devastating effect in a sprint finish. A slow pace neutralises the front runner's advantage and sets up a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Back From Dubai goes too fast early or gets headed mid-race
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical mess with no clear pace angle, leading to a scrambling finish where any horse with a clear run can prevail. Experience and tactical nous become crucial in a muddling contest.

races.paceDynamic: James Park Woods is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead in the early stages. With all other runners showing hold-up tendencies, he'll dictate terms through moderate fractions over this 1m4f trip without serious pressure. The lack of pace angles means the tempo will likely be steady rather than strong, allowing the field to bunch up turning for home. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track James Park Woods closely and those with tactical speed to position handily, rather than pure hold-up horses who may find themselves too far back when the pace fails to develop properly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If James Park Woods gets soft fractions and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: The veteran gets first run on his rivals from the front and his recent Lingfield win suggests he retains enough ability to resist late challenges. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground when the pace hasn't been strong enough to set up their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rally Overcomes
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace allows hold-up horses to get into contention
scenarios.body: Desiderata's recent course win and strong form gives him the class edge in a slowly-run race where his hold-up style can be effective. Robert Havlin's 5lb claim and the horse's proven course form become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Positioning Key
scenarios.trigger: If runners track James Park Woods closely and strike mid-race
scenarios.body: Those able to secure prominent positions behind the leader gain crucial tactical advantage when the pace quickens. Raysham's consistent placing form and Charencey's class edge work in their favour from handy positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If James Park Woods stops quickly and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test where recent form and fitness trump tactics. Mooretown Lad's recent consistency and United Force's solid placing record give them chances in a muddling contest.

watchPoints.text: James Park Woods could get such soft fractions on the lead that he becomes very difficult to peg back in the closing stages
Desiderata's hold-up style may be compromised if the pace doesn't develop strongly enough to set up his finishing kick
Charencey returning after 186 days could either show freshness and improvement or blow up after the long absence
The lack of early pace could turn this into a sprint finish where recent course experience becomes crucial
Robert Havlin's 5lb claim on Desiderata provides a significant weight advantage in what appears a tight handicap
